description: Localisation des bornes de recharge pour dans les magasins E.LECLERC is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bruno TOULOUT. Location of electric vehicle charging stations made available to the public in E.LECLERC stores. Coverage: Bruno TOULOUT. The portal shows the English title as "Location of electric vehicle charging stations in E.LECLERC stores" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bruno TOULOUT. Its keywords include electrique, irve, eleclerc, vehicule, recharge, borne. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
